book.name: Ephesians
book.title: EPHESIANS PAUL AN FEF IGAYAM EPHESUS YANGAN AURIS

content: Rabob emon Tanat Tayawas
Ainau bag omi on ayuai nan worabob womama yabin omi woifonaseir a wobokomas on fasinai.

On an werai omi on tafanam an yawas komasis on wobigibubunuai; omi on orot komasin on ayu engon safamai ibinetewar on osi auris on wobifonabo, osi sabu iyabon God aurin sebifonaseir on, atonio ayu on ari sabu ebinetewaris.

Ainau bag ot engon tutufin on osi ba ato usit an gogoiai on nanaba tama; ot usit a ati not an gogoi on nanaba bobo tafouren, ot usit an yawasai on, ot sabu engon tutufin ba, ot on God an yatatab emon on baikokosar tatboai mes.
Baise God an kaber on irat kwakwan, a On an nuabo ot aurit on irat kwakwan bag,
ot ati fonaseir fasin emon on ayuai tarabob tamama ato God on Keriso a ot mat iboet tanat yawas itet. God an kaber emon on iyawasim.
Ot Keriso Iesu mat tabikaita on God ibogaiit tagai ayubit an yawas boboun itet onai ot On mat on safamai nan taninetewar.
On atonio bobo ifour onai ra gibui enat aurin on an kaber gagamin fafa bag on ot sabu engon tutufin on itiyoboet mes, ato Keriso Iesu an nuabo emon on an kaber iyoboet.
Omi Keriso wobitutumai on mes God an kaber emon on iyawasim. Omi on men toum woiyawasim on, baise atonio on God an siwar, on mes omi men toum wonifaim wonau omi ami bobo emon on toum woiyawasim.
God on ot ati Fouritotin, ato Keriso mat tabikaita on bobo obis fouren auris wat on ifourit, On atonio bobo on ainau bag ibotitiwag ot aurit nanaba tatafour mes.
Kerisoai on Kaitamom

Omi sabu worarat on men Jew yangan on—Jew yangan omi seyoyorem sau, “Men siaskibubues on,” osi tous seyoyores sau, siaskibubues (atonio askibubu on orot jever tous usisi sebiyamen on)—omi wonnos ainau mamaba womama on.

On an werai omi on men Keriso mat woikaita on. Omi on sabu toumanim ato omi on men God an sabu rurubinim On ebinoanai on. God an dura bobaibasit ainau Jew yangan auris i’yaumatan on amonai on omi wabim nan ambin. Omi atonio tafanamai womama on men God an yawas wobo on a omi God men wosagobai on.
Omi ainau on mabimui bag womama, baise ari on Keriso irarabob an taraiai on iboem wonat Keriso Iesu mat woikaita.

Yabin Keriso Toun on tuf ibo inat ato iyamai Jew yangan a sabu men Jew yangan on sinat sabu kaitamom simatar. On Toun usin emon on osi basusi goa an fafa i’yen a on ibiyames sibigigit bonen on igoros isur.

On Jew yangan asi Baifafaro dura a asi baifafaro asi eta on igorosen, onai sabu kuayo ruam magis ta ta on itboes sitnat Kerisoai sitikaita sabu bobous kaitamom wat sitmatar, on etaiai on tuf iyamai imatar.
Keriso nabai irarabob nan on basusi gigit i’yen on igoros; nab emon on, On usis ruam ta ta on iboes sinat usin kaitamom simatar a On iboes imatabir men God aurin.
On mes Keriso inat ato tuf an Wasagobin on ikurereb omi sabu men Jew yangan aurim, omi God emon on nanenei bag womama, a Jew yangan on God aurin on bisinai bag semama.
Keriso emon on, ot engon tutufin Jew yangan a sabu men Jew yangan, on fofonin tannat Ayu kaitamomai Tamat nanai tantawar.
On mes omi sabu men Jew yangan omi on men sabu toumanim o nanawanotim on; omi on ari wonat God an sabu a an dam warar mes womatar.
Omi mat on goa arir tutut ato baiyoyobotis a aubairuruotis sirorouin on tefanai nan siyonim, Keriso Iesu Toun on arir gagamin bag on goa aurin—
Keriso Toun on goa engon tutufin ebotan ebiyamai erarat enat Bada an tafaror goa kakafaiin mes.
Omi wonat Keriso mat wobikaita on omi mat on sabu fani mat kaitamomai siyonim efan menan God an Ayu emama on nan.
